map.将粘贴的多行文本批量转换为 Markdown 引用块（每行前加 >），便于在文档: Convert pasted multi-line text into Markdown blockquotes in bulk (prefix each line with >), for quoting others or adding annotation notes in a document.
map.引用他人内容：把选中段落批量加上 > 前缀，生成规范 blockquote。: Quoting someone else: add a > prefix to selected paragraphs in bulk to produce a proper blockquote.
map.多级引用与嵌套：演示如何在引用内再引用，保持缩进正确。: Multi-level and nested quotes: show how to quote inside a quote while keeping indentation correct.
map.写文档「提示/警告」框：用引用块承载 tip/note 内容。: Writing 'tip/warning' boxes in docs: use blockquotes to carry tip/note content.
map.：粘贴 3 行文字，工具在每行前加「> 」，得到「> 第一行\n> 第二行\n>:
: pasting 3 lines, the tool prefixes each line with '> ' to get '> line one
> line two
> line three', rendered as a continuous blockquote; blank lines can break it into separate quotes.
map.在子行前缀用「> > 」即可形成二级引用；层级越多前缀 > 越多，注意层级间用空: Use the '> > ' prefix on child lines to form a second-level quote; more levels mean more > in the prefix, and blank lines between levels read more easily.
map.可以，引用块内再用代码围栏即可；但缩进与围栏要正确闭合，否则会破坏引用结构。: Yes, you can put code fences inside a blockquote; but indentation and fences must close properly or the quote structure breaks.
